correctness.rationale: Because [L,L]=V is characteristic, automorphisms have block form [[a,0],[w,S]] and ST=aTS. Multiplicity-preserving scalars permute eigenblocks. For a≠1, fixing the t-coordinate forces it zero and each eigenvalue cycle is governed by an unconstrained GL block product. For a=1, w lies in im(S-I) in exactly q^(n-k) translation choices yielding one additional fixed dimension, versus q^n-q^(n-k) choices. q-subspace Möbius inversion gives each GL_s 1-eigenspace coefficient. Independently enumerated ALL q=3, eigenspaces dimension (1,1) automorphism matrices including translations; obtained exact polynomial coefficients (18,39,14,1), total72, as claimed. Infinite formula follows from block and Möbius proof, not the finite check.
